limitations: Explicit year/location queries were inspected; no dates were inferred from another Gregorian year.
The publisher's default location was inconsistent in cached search results. Each stored source was fetched with an explicit city ID and checked against the page title.
No tourism photographs, ritual prose, artwork or complete calendar compilation is redistributed. Records contain selected civil-date facts and source references.
No claim of temple/organiser confirmation or universal regional religious authority. Future uncertain periods remain excluded.
Sources were examined as explicit calendar day blocks. Repeated names in later descriptive prose were excluded; each requested constituent label occurs once in its family sequence.
This is an initial source-reviewed set within the wider Pan-India register, not a fixed coverage target or a completed coverage audit.
